scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)

step_by_step_workflow.portal_action: Select State -> Select Electricity Distribution Company (DISCOM) -> Enter Consumer Account Number -> Enter Mobile Number & Email
Apply for Rooftop Solar installation. DISCOM checks technical feasibility of grid transformer. Once approved, choose registered vendor from portal.
Vendor installs solar modules and inverter. Apply for net meter. DISCOM inspects installation and commissions bidirectional net meter.
Submit bank details and upload cancelled cheque on portal. Central Government releases subsidy directly to bank account within 30 days.
